mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may inhibit estrogen metabolism via CYP450 enzyme inhibition and increase estrogen levels, while estrogens may enhance MAOI effects through altered hepatic metabolism and increased sympathomimetic sensitivity.
action: Monitor for signs of estrogen excess (thrombosis, hypertension) and MAOI potentiation; consider alternative contraception if possible, or use lowest effective estrogen dose with close clinical monitoring.
